entities.name: Jovan Subotić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jovan Subotić was a Serbian lawyer, writer, politician and academic. An ardent Serbian and pan-Slavic patriot, Subotić was a delegate to the first Slavic Congress of 1848 and was a prominent Serb representative in the Habsburg monarchy.
